text.content:
A junction of old routes, Silent enough that it's clearly seen more use than the maps suggest.

GM Notes

Clue: A clue toward the floor's deeper story: the Bone Choir has been rebuilding an army out of everyone who's ever died on this floor - including, eventually, the party.

Hazard: A ward etched into the doorway reacts to anyone who isn't already marked as an ally (DC 18 to detect and counter).

Encounter: Roll a random encounter check when the party lingers here more than a few minutes - something has noticed them.
